issues.statement: During this office's tenure the Union's MGNREGS fund release to West Bengal remained frozen under Section 27 (from 9 Mar 2022), so wage funds did not flow to Birbhum until a June 2026 resumption. The freeze was imposed UPSTREAM by the Union, not by the district office — the office administered a district cut off at source.
